Medical AI Needs Bedside Manners

Aurélie Jean and Sébastien Abgrall

Even the most accurate medical AI tools have little value if they make patients uneasy or doctors find them too cumbersome. A comfort-by-design approach could overcome these obstacles by involving patients and practitioners in development and ensuring that new systems work with existing medical practices.

BSIP/Universal Images Group via Getty Images

Nov 12, 2026
4 min read

PARIS—AI is quickly finding its way into almost every industry, making models more precise and predictive. In medicine, AI tools are already helping patients take a more active role in managing their health care and giving doctors access to information that was previously difficult, if not impossible, to obtain.
